reportArtifacts.note: registration, cell, run and report identities over canonical JSON, plus the shared envelope stating its keyless screen rows analytic
the shared envelope states the keyless answer rows analytic; nothing here bought a provider answer
the shared envelope keeps the paid historic rows as stated legacy-unrecorded absences; no old row is backfilled and new live rows must carry full identities
the shared envelope states the analytic recall/ceiling rows not-run

cases.title: Ollama with an omitted base equals the suite-default base

expect.detail: the suite's resolveEndpoint is the only endpoint authority; an omitted base and its explicit default resolve to one normalized base and therefore one effective identity

cases.observed: both spellings normalize to http://localhost:11434/v1 and resolve to one effective identity

cases.title: LM Studio with an omitted base equals the suite-default base

expect.detail: same normalized base, same effective identity

cases.observed: both spellings normalize to http://localhost:1234/v1 and resolve to one effective identity

cases.title: A trailing slash does not change the normalized base

expect.detail: suite normalization strips the trailing slash; both spellings are one base

cases.observed: both spellings normalize to https://example.com/v1 and resolve to one effective identity

cases.title: A pasted /chat/completions path does not change the normalized base

expect.detail: suite normalization removes the pasted chat path; both spellings are one base

cases.observed: both spellings normalize to https://example.com/v1 and resolve to one effective identity

cases.title: Reordered members of the same registry document hash equally

expect.detail: canonical RFC 8785 hashing makes member order irrelevant: same registry revision, same profile identity

cases.observed: reordered members hash to one canonical revision

cases.title: A different chat model is a different effective identity

expect.detail: the selected model is part of the effective role identity

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different normalized base is a different effective identity

expect.detail: two hosts resolving the same model behind different bases cannot masquerade as one run

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different temperature is a different effective identity

expect.detail: inference controls are identity fields, not incidental settings

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different reasoning control is a different effective identity

expect.detail: thinking controls change what the provider does and therefore the identity

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different structured-output schema revision is a different effective identity

expect.detail: the response contract shapes every answer; its revision is identity

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different prompt revision is a different effective identity

expect.detail: the versioned template is identity; user text and retrieved evidence are not

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different tool input schema is a different effective identity

expect.detail: the effective tool manifest is taken from the compiled toolbox; a changed tool schema changes the identity

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

expect.detail: the singleton embedding identity is `{ model, dims }`; a model change is a different corpus space

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different embedding width is a different effective identity

expect.detail: width is identity; vectors of different widths never rank against each other

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different policy component revision is a different effective identity

expect.detail: the selected policy/ranker component reference and revision are identity; the component's values stay owned by its package

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different effective budget ceiling is a different effective identity

expect.detail: the effective ceiling changes what a run may do and is identity

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A different rate card is a different effective identity

expect.detail: cost provenance is identity: a stale price must not silently stand behind a fresh number

cases.observed: the changed value produces a different effective identity

cases.title: A duplicate candidate id refuses

expect.detail: unique ids are asserted by the registry schema's $query at validation time

cases.observed: validation refuses with TCFG1004 /candidates

cases.title: A child extending a missing parent refuses

expect.detail: reference integrity is a schema assertion, not a runtime surprise

cases.observed: validation refuses with TCFG1002 /profiles/1/extends

cases.title: A profile whose embedding references a chat candidate refuses

expect.detail: role/candidate kind agreement is asserted at validation time

cases.observed: validation refuses with TCFG1006 /profiles/0/embedding

cases.title: A registry member named like a credential refuses

expect.detail: every object closes its properties; an undeclared member cannot be carried, so a credential value has no place to live

cases.observed: validation refuses with TCFG1007 /candidates; TCFG1014 /candidates/0/apiKey

cases.title: A candidate base URL carrying userinfo refuses

expect.detail: a credential-bearing base can enter no registry, identity, report or cache key; the sentinel must appear in no serialized outcome

cases.observed: validation refuses with TCFG1007 /candidates; TCFG1007 /candidates/1; TCFG1007 /candidates/1/baseUrl; TCFG1007 /candidates/1/baseUrl; TCFG1013 /candidates/1/baseUrl

cases.title: A result row referencing an absent identity refuses

expect.detail: every `run` row must resolve to exactly one identity in the table; the envelope's $query refuses a dangling reference

cases.observed: the identity envelope refuses a dangling run-row reference as TCFG1018

cases.title: A profile inheritance cycle refuses

expect.detail: ancestry is resolved root-to-leaf; a cycle is a stable issue, never a stack overflow

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1003 /profiles/1

cases.title: A request for an undeclared capability tag refuses

expect.detail: a tag is a declared intent; an undeclared spelling resolves to nothing and falls through to nothing

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1001 /tag

cases.title: A required credential slot the host has not configured refuses

expect.detail: slot presence is a host fact; an unavailable slot refuses before any client exists, and no fallback candidate is substituted silently for a pinned candidate

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1008 /roles/answer/candidate

cases.title: A pinned model the host does not offer refuses

expect.detail: a pinned candidate the host cannot serve refuses; it never falls through to another candidate or tag

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1009 /roles/answer/candidate

cases.title: A required provider feature the host lacks refuses

expect.detail: a candidate's declared feature requirements are checked against the host manifest before a paid answer

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1010 /roles/answer/candidate

cases.title: A required tool absent from the host allowlist refuses

expect.detail: a tool request is never permission; missing required tools refuse and extra host tools never silently enter

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1011 /roles/answer/tools

cases.title: Registry and host disagreeing on embedding dimensions refuses

expect.detail: registry dimensions must equal the host probe/reply under the suite's sameIdentity semantics; disagreement refuses before indexed work

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1012 /embedding

cases.title: A tag with no available candidate refuses instead of falling through

expect.detail: no available candidate returns an issue; it never falls through to another tag, the legacy profile or the offline model

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1015 /roles/chat/capability

cases.title: A profile budget above a host hard ceiling refuses

expect.detail: budgets remain host ceilings; a profile may lower one and can never raise one

cases.observed: refused as a value with TCFG1016 /budget/maxCalls

cases.title: A genuinely unconfigured legacy host stays grounded/offline

expect.detail: default settings produce the built-in embedder identity and no chat wire; that fallback is intentional product behavior and only the unconfigured legacy request keeps it

cases.observed: the unconfigured legacy request resolves to no chat wire and the built-in hash-trigram-64 identity at 64 dimensions (identity 55239dafdc13…)

cases.title: A custom provider without a base is a stated unavailable value

expect.detail: both the environment reader and the suite refuse a custom provider with no base before any client is created

cases.observed: readAiEnv states 'AI0001: provider 'custom' needs a baseUrl' and the suite refuses to resolve custom without a base

cases.title: A missing key is a stated live-tier skip, not a failure

expect.detail: the keyless tiers stay runnable; the reason names the variable, never a value

cases.observed: a missing key is a stated skip naming OPENROUTER_AI_KEY; keyless tiers stay runnable

cases.title: An explicit half-configured embed request must refuse, not silently become the built-in

expect.detail: today a wire request with no model silently becomes hash-trigram-64, making a requested remote indistinguishable from requested offline; the campaign keeps fallback only for the explicit unconfigured legacy state

cases.observed: an explicit half-configured embed request refuses as TCFG1021 naming the missing fields; only the unconfigured legacy state keeps the built-in fallback

cases.title: Environment integers must be schema-normalized, never partially parsed

expect.detail: today parseInt turns '4x' into 4 and '2.5' into 2, and zero/negatives silently become the default; the campaign records explicit, defaulted and rejected states

cases.observed: guards are schema-normalized with recorded states: '4x' -> rejected, '2.5' -> rejected, '0' -> rejected, '-1' -> rejected; '7' -> explicit 7; absent -> defaulted

cases.title: Corrupt persisted settings must be a typed migration/refusal value

expect.detail: today the settings read structurally merges a corrupt row into typed runtime state; the campaign validates stored rows before treating them as Settings

cases.observed: a corrupt stored row is refused or normalized before it becomes typed settings

cases.title: Settings reads must expose slot status, never credential values

expect.detail: today settings.get returns stored API keys and the renderer token verbatim; the campaign makes credential values write-only host slots

cases.observed: the public settings read returns null for every credential value with slot statuses beside them, and the config inspection carries no secret byte

cases.title: The local wire guard must not disagree with the suite's endpoint authority

expect.detail: chatWireConfigured says false for Ollama/LM Studio without a base while resolveEndpoint resolves their suite defaults; the campaign deletes the local endpoint decision

cases.observed: the local guard agrees with the suite endpoint authority for every provider

cases.title: URL userinfo must be refused before suite resolution

expect.detail: the suite preserves userinfo in the normalized base and the replay layer treats that base as credential-free; Tangle must refuse such a base as host policy before calling the suite

cases.observed: a credential-bearing base is refused as TCFG1013 before suite resolution on both host paths, and the sentinel appears in no issue

cases.title: New runs must carry a config identity reference

expect.detail: today zero of the three desktop run-producing handlers stores a config/profile identity; old rows stay honestly legacy-unrecorded and are never backfilled

cases.observed: a run stores its identity reference before work, a row without one reads as legacy-unrecorded and is never backfilled, and a config-aware run cannot finish without saying what stack produced it

cases.title: Chat answers must reference an identity; a provider label is display metadata

expect.detail: today a chat message stores only a 'provider/model' label; the campaign records the identity reference and provider-reported usage beside it

cases.observed: a chat answer stores its identity reference (55239dafdc13…) beside the display label, and the identity is retrievable from the repository

cases.title: Every applicable benchmark artifact must carry the shared identity envelope

expect.detail: today only the policy report has registration/cell/run/report identities; recall, QA and QA-live rows have no shared run identity and must gain the envelope or an explicit not-run/legacy-unrecorded status

cases.observed: all 4 artifacts carry the shared identity envelope with validated run/not-run/legacy-unrecorded rows
